A1.justification: Both complete 15-page PDFs describe S2L-PO and include Appendices A–F. Pages 2–15 have identical extracted text and pixel-identical renderings. Title-page differences do not limit comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original S2L-PO experiments, including mathematical reasoning and CommonsenseQA evaluations, diversity measurements, and ablations.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the same original benchmark results, diversity measurements, and ablation experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 and Algorithm 1 retain the same frozen small-model explorer, mixed rollout generation, progressive annealing, and GRPO updates.

E1.justification: Both versions train on deduplicated DAPO17k and evaluate on AIME24, AIME25, MATH-500, OlympiadBench, and CommonsenseQA. No task or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: GRPO remains the comparator in Tables 1–2. The high-temperature, small-only, abrupt-switch, and other comparison variants retain identical participation in their corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix C retain identical model configurations, evaluation metrics, 16 rollouts per evaluation question, nothink mode, training settings, and annealing schedules.

E4.justification: The diversity measurements and filtering control in Tables 3–4, plus small-only, abrupt-switch, and transition-length analyses in Figures 5–7, are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Both retain the same point estimates and curves without adding seed counts, independent-run uncertainty summaries, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings are identical. For example, Table 1 retains AIME24 Pass@1 of 23.8% for 1.7B-to-8B S2L-PO and 15.0% for 8B GRPO.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations in Sections 2–3, together with Appendix E's covariance bounds, assumptions, proofs, and qualifications, are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about small-model policy-level diversity, progressive annealing, improved reasoning performance, faster convergence, and reduced rollout compute.

C2.justification: Explanations involving temporal coherence, diversity, distribution mismatch, and annealing are unchanged. Appendix F retains the same limitations concerning model coverage, task domains, and non-verifiable or open-ended rewards.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, preprocessing, implementation details, and deployment information in Section 4.1 and Appendices A, C, and D are identical. The code link and release statements are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and Section 5 positioning relative to token-level exploration, distillation, and off-policy methods are identical.

P1.justification: The title page swaps Yiming Ren and Yiran Xu's order, changes 'Jujie Wang' to 'Junjie Wang', revises affiliations, and updates the arXiv stamp. Scientific prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Title-page changes produce limited author-line spacing, affiliation-footnote wrapping, and arXiv-sidebar changes. All figures, tables, and pages 2–15 render identically.

improvement.justification: The revision is confined to title-page authorship, affiliation, and presentation edits. Scientific content, empirical evidence, theoretical arguments, reproducibility information, and limitations are identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
